entries.title: Fewer short pauses each minute while your changes' checks run
entries.body: While checks ran on your changes, the app read them about once a minute and updated each change's card. Every reading rebuilt all your open cards, so when many readings came back together the window could pause for a few tenths of a second. The app now rebuilds the cards once for all the readings that come back together, and it finds where each card's work came from with fewer reads.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; the window pauses less, which a still picture cannot show.
entries.noDocsSite: No docs site page describes how long rebuilding the cards takes.
